reviews.summary: The cards I checked each link to a /lang/<slug>/ page that returns 200 and lists the repo. The home method section has a working /lang/python/ link, and the footer, JSON and card URLs are intact. I could not check the commit hash or the omit-link case for an unknown language.

The live stats.json and today.json keep the scan-time "generated" value (01:13:15Z) after a later rebuild (03:09:47Z), and the schemas look unchanged. The git-status and real-scan criteria can't be seen from outside, and the site has no commit marker, so the verdict is inconclusive.

The live stats.json "generated" value equals the build time, not the last real scan time. That is the defect the task was meant to fix, and the implementer claimed 01:13:15Z, which is not what the site shows. The code and the git-status criteria could not be checked because the GitHub hosts are blocked.

The Go language page meets the main criteria. It lists 64 alphabetical entries matching stats.json, links the yes cells to /go/ hops with ids that match the repo cards, and keeps the footer with a UTC time. I could not observe the 0-AGENTS.md case, so the verdict is inconclusive.

On the live site, stats.json and today.json show generated 2026-11-02T18:26:07Z, which equals build.json last_checked. data_delayed is false, even though the site was rebuilt at 05:10Z. I could not confirm the code-level criteria (idempotent history write, a normal scan still writing history, schema unchanged) because the repo hosts are blocked, so the verdict is inconclusive.

The live Go language page has the 'AGENTS.md in Go (64)' list, matching stats.json. All 134 yes cells link to /go/ hops, and the ids I checked match the repo cards. The page has no scripts other than ld+json and no forms, and the footer shows the updated time.

The fix is live: history is written only when a scan checked at least one repo, and stats.json 'generated' still shows the last real scan (2026-11-02T18:26:07Z) after a 05:10Z rebuild. Schemas and the delay logic look unchanged, and data_delayed is false.

The live robots.txt disallows only /go/ for all agents, keeps Allow: / and the Sitemap line, and sitemap.xml lists no redirect URLs. A sample /go/ page still forwards to GitHub, and no per-bot blocks or scripts were added.
The live build.json and stats.json meet all four acceptance criteria. A rebuild happened (built_at 08:15:06Z) without moving generated or last_checked, which both stay at 2026-11-03T07:13:27Z.
The /brand/ page, avatar.svg and the favicon all match the acceptance criteria. The chosen avatar A is served as the favicon, and no text or AI mark appears in the images.

The repo entry page has the useful / not useful links and a prefilled Report an error link. Both vote pages meta-refresh back to the entry, and the page adds no forms, cookies or JS, with the footer intact. The home-page convention cards and the language-list entries have no vote links; I read the task's "entry" as repo entries, so this is not a failure.

The home page now states the limit under the headline, has both working anchor links, and the method section carries the paths, nested-files, lang-pages and baseline lines. No scripts or forms, footer kept, no advice or ranking, and stats.json 'generated' did not move.

The home page now names the exact checked paths in both the limit sentence and the method section, and still says nested files are not checked and that the count is presence only. stats.json is consistent: its method has no root wording, its generated timestamp predates the home rebuild, and the footer, no-form and no-script requirements hold.

po_digest_md:
**agentsmd-tracker, cycle 03.11 19:07 UTC**

**What happened.** On 03.11 the first posts went out in four channels (bluesky, telegram, mastodon, threads). The mastodon post brought the most visitors: 5 human sources and 83 requests. None of them engaged. Bluesky brought 3 sources (1 engaged), threads 1 (1 engaged), telegram 0. All 10 persona runs succeeded: the language pages, cards, citation line and JSON contract work. On 02.11 ClaudeBot made 882 of 885 requests to /go/. The robots.txt fix (T-0011) went live on 03.11, and we will compare after the 04.11 metrics.

**Decisions:**
- **Mastodon:** a post on 04.11 at 09:00 UTC, linking to the home page rather than stats.json, to see whether its visitors stay. Without it the channel would sit idle until 09.11.
- **Plan slots for 07.11:** bluesky and telegram posts, both at 05:45 UTC.
- **Long Go page (193 repos):** deferred. The short AGENTS.md list already sits at the top, and a filter would need JS.
- **Different timestamps in build.json vs stats.json:** rejected. They differ by design (build time vs scan time).

**Waiting for you:** please have ops add `/stats.json`, `/today.json`, `/feed.xml` and `/llms.txt` as metrics targets in product.yaml. Without them, goal G3b (requests to the JSON/RSS files from sources other than us) cannot be measured during the pilot.

**Next:** at 04.11 05:45 UTC the first pilot-day post (T-0010), then the fix for data dates (T-0012).

**Cost:** $9.32 of $20 spent today.
